description: Create a draft sequence from a template returned by list_sequence_templates, exactly as the dashboard does. Mobile journeys start with a branch on whether the contact is reachable by push (an active device on a platform with APNs, FCM or web push set up): those contacts get push and in-app, everyone else gets email (in-app reaches both). Every wait lands in 09:00-21:00 in the contact's own timezone, email steps respect the company frequency cap, the template's continue condition stops the journey when the contact converts, and an attribution goal is created on the sequence. Emails are written by AI from the brand (30-60 seconds); push and in-app copy comes from the template, so review it with get_sequence and edit with update_sequence_node before enable_sequence. Calendar templates that count down to key dates are dashboard-only; use create_sequence with keyDates instead.
